state:
- The primary maturation assay is run in pyrimidine-starved medium (measured uridine below 1 micromolar) while passage still treats 100 micromolar uridine rescue as proof of on-target DHODH dependence, so a pass can reflect a condition that physiologic uridine would reverse. Make maturation at a verified human plasma or marrow uridine concentration, with free teriflunomide at or below the documented unbound approved-dose ceiling, the primary efficacy readout, and keep the depleted medium as a mechanism-only arm.
- The DHODH positive control, AHR antagonist, and kinase tool are unnamed and unconcentrated, and the OXPHOS or TCA falsifier is assigned to ROS-low and cytarabine-residual side cultures rather than to the same primary blasts that must mature. Name those three reagents, match them to the dihydroorotate and pyrimidine-nucleotide engagement window, and require oxygen-consumption and TCA-intermediate measurements on the primary cultures at 6–24 hours.
- The drug–target pair is the direct approved-inhibitor extension of the S4 DHODH differentiation premise, and the pre-fixed monocytic gates (low CD11b and CD14, forms past the promonocyte) can score a genuine myeloid differentiation response as failure when maturation is granulocytic. Pre-commit to a prior-art retirement check against exposure-matched leflunomide or teriflunomide AML data, and add a parallel granulocytic score so lineage mismatch is reported separately from mechanism failure.
